name: Koromaru
source:
Koromaru is an albino Shiba Inu who is a former member of the SEES, and the only dog in the world who can control a persona. In Persona 4 Ultimax, he tags alongside [url=/c53754]Ken[/url] and is part of the battles as well.

[From [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Koromaru]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]

He wields the [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Cerberus]Cerberus[/url] persona, a monster in Greek mythology, that guards the gates of Hades.
